basis: jinshu:053:s0169 reports 帝感閻纘之言，立思子台, in the crown-prince mourning episode. zizhitongjian:083:s0200 reports 西戎校尉司馬閻纘輿棺詣闕上書 and the argument about 漢戾太子. The same full Chinese name and particular appeal for the wronged heir connect the memorialist to the words moving the emperor. Tongjian s0197–s0198 gives 永康元年; s0204 identifies 圃之孫. English Yan Xun versus Yan Zuan does not override the Chinese evidence.
